attchmntText: Arshiya Limited has informed the Exchange about reasons for Delayed/Non-submission of Financial  for quarter and half year ended on September 2026.
desc: Reasons for Delayed/Non-submission of Financial Results
voiceSummary: Arshiya Limited disclosed reasons for delaying the submission of un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The company is under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process since April 23, 2024, with Resolution Professional Pankaj Mahajan exercising powers. Delays stem from logistical challenges following the registered office relocation effective April 29, 2024, and significant staff attrition where 50 out of 71 employees resigned between July 30 and August 2, 2024. The Resolution Professional is currently collecting financial data, a process hindered by the non-receipt of financials from multiple subsidiaries. The company aims to submit the results at the earliest.

attchmntText: Arshiya Limited has informed the Exchange about Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
